entry_point: After Intermediate MPC (Maths, Physics, Chemistry)
required_exams: AP EAPCET (Engineering stream) for colleges in Andhra Pradesh; JEE Main for NITs, IIITs and other centrally funded institutes; JEE Advanced (top ~2,50,000 in JEE Main) for the IITs
eligibility: AP EAPCET: Intermediate MPC with at least 45% in the qualifying subjects (40% for reserved categories) and AP local/non-local status. JEE Main: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths, no minimum-marks bar, up to 3 consecutive years. JEE Advanced: at most 2 attempts in consecutive years
govt_private_options: Government and private engineering colleges across Andhra Pradesh through AP EAPCET counselling; NITs, IIITs and IITs through JEE Main / JEE Advanced
next_step: Jobs in industry; M.Tech or PSU recruitment through GATE (any 3rd-year-or-higher engineering student can sit it; score valid 3 years); or UPSC Engineering Services for central government engineering posts (engineering degree, age 21-30, with relaxations)
source: Exams tab (verified): AP EAPCET 2026 Instruction Booklet (JNTU Kakinada for APSCHE), JEE Main 2026 and JEE (Advanced) 2026 notices, GATE 2027 (IIT Madras); UPSC Engineering Services Examination 2027, Notice No. 02/2027-ENGG dated 16.09.2026: upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notif-ESEP-2027-Engl-160926.pdf

entry_point: After Intermediate BiPC
required_exams: NEET-UG (NTA) - the single entrance exam for MBBS, BDS and AYUSH seats in India; AP seats are allotted by Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences counselling
eligibility: Class 12 / Intermediate with Physics, Chemistry and Biology: 50% for General, 40% for OBC/SC/ST. At least 17 years old by 31 December of the admission year; no upper age limit. To qualify in NEET-UG 2026: 50th percentile (General/EWS), 40th percentile (SC/ST/BC)
govt_private_options: Government, self-financing and private medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh, all through NEET-UG rank and Dr. NTR UHS counselling (competent authority and management quotas)
next_step: After the MBBS course and internship, register with the medical council to practise, or go on to postgraduate (MD/MS) specialisation
source: Exams tab (verified): NTA NEET (UG) 2026 notices; Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences, Detailed Notification for MBBS & BDS admissions 2026-27: drntr.uhsap.in/index/notification/20260901205809253.pdf

entry_point: After Class 12 / Intermediate (any stream)
required_exams: CLAT (UG) for the National Law Universities; AP LAWCET for 5-year LL.B. in Andhra Pradesh universities and law colleges
eligibility: CLAT: Class 12 pass, any stream. AP LAWCET (5-year LL.B.): Intermediate with 45% (42% BC, 40% SC/ST). AP LAWCET also admits graduates with 45% to the 3-year LL.B.
govt_private_options: National Law Universities through CLAT; university and affiliated (government and private) law colleges in Andhra Pradesh through AP LAWCET
next_step: Enrol as an advocate with the State Bar Council, then pass the All India Bar Examination (held by the Bar Council of India) to get the certificate of practice for any court in India; or judicial service exams, corporate law or an LL.M.
source: Exams tab (verified): CLAT 2027 press release (Consortium of NLUs); AP LAWCET & PGLCET-2026 Instruction Booklet V2 (Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam for APSCHE); Bar Council of India, All India Bar Examination: allindiabarexamination.com/about.html

entry_point: After any bachelor's degree (final-year students may apply)
required_exams: UPSC Civil Services Examination: Preliminary (objective) -> Main (written) -> Personality Test
eligibility: A degree from a recognised university. Age 21-32 on 1 August of the exam year; upper age relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 for OBC, and for ex-servicemen and PwBD. Attempts: 6 (General/EWS), 9 (OBC and PwBD), unlimited for SC/ST within the age limit
govt_private_options: Government only: IAS, IPS, IFS and other Group A and B central services through UPSC
next_step: Allocation to a service by rank and preference, training at the service academy, then a career in public administration, policing or diplomacy
source: Exams tab (verified): UPSC Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSE (04.02.2026): upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notif-CSP-2026-Engl-060226Rev.pdf

career_name: State Civil Services (AP Group services via APPSC)
entry_point: After any bachelor's degree
required_exams: APPSC Group-I (and Group-II and other) exams: Preliminary -> Main -> Interview
eligibility: A bachelor's degree from a recognised university (a few posts need a specific degree, and police posts have physical standards). Age limits and reservations are in each detailed notification on psc.ap.gov.in
govt_private_options: Government only: Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission recruits for posts such as Deputy Collector, Deputy Superintendent of Police, Assistant Commissioner of State Tax and Accounts Officer (Treasury)
next_step: Posting in the state administrative, police, revenue or finance services, with promotions within the state cadre
source: Exams tab (verified): APPSC Brief Notification No. 07/2026 (15/09/2026), Group-I Services: psc.ap.gov.in/Documents/NotificationDocuments/Group_I_072026.pdf

entry_point: After Intermediate (D.El.Ed route, primary classes) or after a degree (B.Ed route)
required_exams: D.El.Ed or B.Ed -> AP TET (Paper 1A for Classes I-V, Paper 2A for Classes VI-VIII) -> AP DSC Teacher Recruitment Test for government posts
eligibility: An NCTE-recognised D.El.Ed or B.Ed (RCI for special education) with the marks set in the APTET Information Bulletin; final-semester students may sit AP TET. Unlimited attempts; the certificate is valid for life
govt_private_options: AP TET is required to teach Classes I-VIII in AP government, local body, model, residential, welfare, aided and private schools. Government posts are filled through AP DSC, where the TET score carries 20% weightage
next_step: Secondary Grade Teacher or School Assistant through DSC, with promotion to headmaster and education officer posts over time
source: Exams tab (verified): Government of AP, School Education Department, APTET-JUNE 2026 Notification No.01-APTET-JUNE-2026 dated 05-06-2026: tet2dsc.apcfss.in/TET-PDF/APTET-2026 Notification.pdf

entry_point: After Class 12 (NDA) or after a degree (CDS)
required_exams: NDA & NA exam (UPSC) after Class 12, or CDS exam (UPSC) after graduation; both followed by the SSB interview and medical tests
eligibility: NDA: Class 12 (any stream for the Army wing; Physics and Maths for Air Force and Navy), unmarried, within the birth-date window in each notice (open to men and women). CDS: a bachelor's degree (engineering degree for some IMA/INA/AFA entries); age limits by academy
govt_private_options: Government only: National Defence Academy, Indian Military Academy, Indian Naval Academy, Air Force Academy and Officers Training Academy
next_step: Commission as an officer in the Army, Navy or Air Force after training, then promotion through the officer ranks
source: Exams tab (verified): UPSC Examination Notice No.10/2026-NDA-II and No.11/2026-CDS-II: upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notif-NDA-II-2026-Engl-200526.pdf, Notif-CDS-II-2026-Engl-200526.pdf

entry_point: After Class 12 (Foundation route) or after graduation (Direct Entry route)
required_exams: CA Foundation -> CA Intermediate -> Practical Training (2 years) -> CA Final -> ICAI membership
eligibility: Foundation: Class 12 pass (any stream), no age limit. Direct Entry to Intermediate: commerce graduates/post-graduates with at least 55%, other graduates with at least 60%, or those who passed the ICSI / ICMAI intermediate level
govt_private_options: A professional qualification of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (a statutory body), not a college degree; practical training is done under a practising chartered accountant
next_step: Membership of ICAI, then practice, audit and tax firms, or finance roles in companies and government
source: Exams tab (verified): ICAI Important Announcement No. 13-CA(EXAM)/SEPTEMBER-NOVEMBER/2026; ICAI FAQs on the CA course (icai-call-sahayata.icai.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/About-CA-Course-Oro-FAQ.pdf): Direct Entry eligibility and practical training

entry_point: After any bachelor's degree
required_exams: IBPS PO and IBPS Clerk for participating public sector banks; SBI PO for the State Bank of India (Prelims -> Mains -> interview/assessment for PO)
eligibility: A degree in any discipline. IBPS PO: age 20-30; IBPS Clerk: age 20-28 and proficiency in the official language of the State/UT applied for; SBI PO: age 21-30 (all with the usual SC/ST/OBC/PwBD relaxations)
govt_private_options: Public sector banks through IBPS and SBI exams; private banks recruit through their own processes
next_step: Probationary Officer (Junior Management Scale I) or clerk (Customer Service Associate), with promotion through the bank's officer scales
source: Exams tab (verified): IBPS CRP-PO/MTs-XVI (30.06.2026), IBPS CRP-CSA-XVI (01.08.2026), SBI PO Advertisement CRPD/PO/2026-27/09

entry_point: After Intermediate / Class 12 with Maths
required_exams: NATA (Council of Architecture); some institutes also accept JEE Main Paper 2
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths, or a 3-year diploma with Maths; no upper age limit. Check the minimum marks in the current NATA brochure on nata.in
govt_private_options: B.Arch (5 years) at Council of Architecture-recognised government and private colleges
next_step: Register with the Council of Architecture to practise as an architect; or M.Arch, urban planning or practice in a firm
source: Exams tab (verified): Council of Architecture, nata.in (NATA 2026 schedule and eligibility)

entry_point: After Intermediate MPC or BiPC
required_exams: AP EAPCET: Engineering stream for B.Pharmacy (MPC) and Pharm.D, Agriculture & Pharmacy stream for BiPC students
eligibility: Intermediate MPC or BiPC with at least 45% in the qualifying subjects (40% for reserved categories) and AP local/non-local status
govt_private_options: Government and private pharmacy colleges in Andhra Pradesh through AP EAPCET counselling
next_step: Register with the State Pharmacy Council to work as a pharmacist; or M.Pharm / Pharm.D, or jobs in pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory affairs
source: Exams tab (verified): APEAPCET-2026 Instruction Booklet (JNTU Kakinada for APSCHE): cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET/PDF/APEAPCET2026_Instruction_Booklet_Engineering_V4.pdf

entry_point: After Intermediate BiPC (with English)
required_exams: NEET-UG; Dr. NTR UHS prepares the state merit list from the NEET-UG rank and allots seats by web counselling
eligibility: Intermediate with Physics, Chemistry and Biology and English as a compulsory subject: 45% in science subjects (40% for SC, ST and BC). At least 17 years old by 31 December of the admission year; no upper age limit
govt_private_options: Colleges affiliated to Dr. NTR UHS (competent authority and management quota seats); male candidates are admitted only in the colleges notified for them
next_step: Four-year (eight-semester) course, then registration as a nurse with the state nursing council; M.Sc Nursing for specialisation or teaching
source: Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences: Prospectus/Regulations for admission into B.Sc. (Nursing) 4-Years Degree Course 2026-27 (drntr.uhsap.in/index/notification/20260909153823350.pdf) and Notification (.../20260909153830487.pdf)

entry_point: After Intermediate MPC or BiPC
required_exams: B.Sc (admission to AP degree colleges through the OAMDC online admissions) -> M.Sc -> Joint CSIR-UGC NET for a research fellowship (JRF), PhD admission or lectureship
eligibility: CSIR-UGC NET: a master's degree with at least 55% (50% for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD/third gender). JRF: at most 30 years old on 1 July of the exam year, relaxable up to 5 years for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/third gender/PwD/women; no upper age limit for Assistant Professor or PhD admission
govt_private_options: Government, aided and private degree colleges in AP through OAMDC; universities and research institutes for M.Sc and PhD
next_step: PhD and research careers in national laboratories and universities, college teaching, or industry R&D
source: OAMDC (APSCHE) FAQs: oamdc.ap.gov.in/FAQS.do; NTA Joint CSIR-UGC NET December 2025 Information Bulletin (chapter 2) and June 2026 FAQs (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3efdf562ce2fb0ad460fd8e9d33e57f57/uploads/2026/05/20260527531592516.pdf)

entry_point: After Intermediate MPC (B.Tech) or after Class 12 (BCA)
required_exams: AP EAPCET (Engineering stream) for B.Tech CSE/IT and related branches; BCA in AP degree colleges through the OAMDC online admissions
eligibility: B.Tech: Intermediate MPC with at least 45% in the qualifying subjects (40% for reserved categories). BCA: as notified on OAMDC for each course
govt_private_options: Government and private engineering colleges through AP EAPCET counselling; government, aided and private degree colleges for BCA through OAMDC
next_step: Jobs in IT services and product companies, M.Tech through GATE, or MCA after BCA
source: Exams tab (verified): APEAPCET-2026 Instruction Booklet; OAMDC (APSCHE) FAQs: oamdc.ap.gov.in/FAQS.do (Computer Applications courses in degree colleges)

entry_point: After Intermediate BiPC (MPC for B.Tech Agricultural Engineering)
required_exams: AP EAPCET (Agriculture & Pharmacy stream) for B.Sc (Agriculture), B.Sc (Horticulture), B.V.Sc & A.H. and B.F.Sc in Andhra Pradesh; CUET-UG for UG seats at ICAR-affiliated universities in other states
eligibility: AP EAPCET: Intermediate BiPC (MPC for Agricultural Engineering) with at least 45% in the qualifying subjects (40% for reserved categories) and AP local/non-local status
govt_private_options: State agricultural, horticultural and veterinary university colleges and their affiliated colleges in Andhra Pradesh through AP EAPCET counselling
next_step: State agriculture, horticulture and animal husbandry department jobs, agribusiness and veterinary practice, or M.Sc/PhD (ICAR AIEEA PG)
source: Exams tab (verified): APEAPCET-2026 Instruction Booklet (courses admitted: B.Sc.(Ag), B.Sc.(Hort), B.V.Sc.&A.H, B.F.Sc, B.Tech (Agr. Engg.)); NTA ICAR AIEEA (PG)-2026 Information Bulletin (UG admission to ICAR-affiliated universities is through CUET-UG)

entry_point: After Class 12 (any stream)
required_exams: NIFT entrance (B.Des, B.F.Tech), NID DAT (B.Des at the National Institutes of Design), UCEED (B.Des at IIT Bombay, Delhi, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Roorkee and IIITDM Jabalpur)
eligibility: NIFT B.Des: Class 12 in any stream, under 24 on 1 August of the admission year (5 years' relaxation for SC/ST/PwD); B.F.Tech needs Maths. UCEED: Class 12 in any stream, born on or after 1 Oct 2002 (1 Oct 1997 for SC/ST/PwD), at most two attempts
govt_private_options: NIFT (20 campuses, including NIFT Hyderabad), the NIDs and the IITs; many private design schools also accept these scores
next_step: Design jobs in fashion, product, communication and interiors, M.Des, or your own studio
source: Exams tab (verified): NIFTEE-2026 Information Bulletin (NTA for NIFT); NID Admissions 2027-28 portal; UCEED 2027 Information Brochure (IIT Bombay)

entry_point: After Class 12 (CSEET route) or after graduation (direct Executive entry)
required_exams: ICSI CSEET -> CS Executive Programme -> CS Professional Programme -> ~21 months practical training -> ICSI membership
eligibility: CSEET: Class 12 pass, any stream; CS Executive: pass CSEET, OR graduates/post-graduates may enter directly without CSEET by paying an exemption fee. Typical duration: Approximately 4-5 years total from Class 12 (CSEET + Executive ~8 months + Professional ~8 months + 21 months practical training), depending on exam attempts
govt_private_options: Govt: N/A - CS is a professional qualification regulated by ICSI, a statutory govt-recognised body, not a college degree. Private: Private coaching institutes support CSEET/Executive/Professional exam prep; practical training typically served under a practising CS or a corporate secretarial department
next_step: Enrol as a Company Secretary with ICSI; career in corporate compliance/governance roles, as an independent practising CS, or in-house company secretarial departments of listed companies
source: admitkard.com Company Secretary (CS) Course 2026 guide

entry_point: After Class 10 / 12 (Foundation) or after a degree (direct Intermediate)
required_exams: CMA Foundation -> CMA Intermediate -> CMA Final -> ICMAI membership
eligibility: Foundation: Class 10 pass to register, with Class 12 (10+2) to be completed; ICSI Foundation passers are exempted. Intermediate: 10+2 and CMA Foundation, or a degree from a recognised university, or engineering students who have completed the 2nd year. Provisional admission is allowed while awaiting results
govt_private_options: A professional qualification of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (a statutory body), not a college degree
next_step: Membership of ICMAI, then cost and management accounting, corporate finance or government roles
source: Institute of Cost Accountants of India, Course Eligibility: icmai.in/ClntStudents/CourseEligibility

entry_point: After Class 12 (RRB NTPC Under Graduate posts) or after a degree (SSC CGL, RRB NTPC Graduate posts)
required_exams: SSC CGL: Tier-I -> Tier-II. RRB NTPC: computer-based tests, then a typing/aptitude test where applicable, document verification and medical exam
eligibility: SSC CGL: a bachelor's degree (some posts need specific subjects); age 18-27, 20-30 or 18-32 depending on the post. RRB NTPC Under Graduate: Class 12 with at least 50% (not required for SC/ST/PwBD/ex-servicemen), age 18-30. RRB NTPC Graduate: a degree, age 18-33. Usual category relaxations apply
govt_private_options: Government only: central ministries and departments (Group B and C posts) through SSC; Indian Railways non-technical posts through the RRBs
next_step: Posts such as Assistant Section Officer, Inspector, Auditor (SSC CGL) or Station Master, clerk and ticket supervisor (RRB NTPC), with departmental promotions
source: Exams tab (verified): SSC Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026 notice (21.05.2026); Railway Recruitment Boards CEN 06/2025 (NTPC Graduate) and CEN 07/2025 (NTPC Under Graduate)

entry_point: After Class 12 (any stream, with English)
required_exams: NCHM JEE (conducted by NTA for the National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology)
eligibility: Passed or appearing in Class 12 with English as a subject; no age limit. A physical fitness certificate is needed at admission
govt_private_options: B.Sc Hospitality and Hotel Administration at NCHMCT-affiliated Institutes of Hotel Management: central, state, PSU, PPP and private
next_step: Management trainee roles in hotels and hospitality, or further study in hospitality management
source: Exams tab (verified): NCHM JEE-2026 Information Bulletin (NTA for NCHMCT)

entry_point: After Intermediate (any stream, though MEC/CEC/HEC/BiPC commonly chosen)
required_exams: BA/BSc Psychology (3 years, merit-based) -> MA/MSc Psychology (2 years) -> for clinical practice: M.Phil Clinical Psychology (2 years) via an RCI-recognised entrance exam (e.g. NIMHANS or CIP Ranchi)
eligibility: UG: Intermediate pass, any stream, merit-based admission (no dedicated national entrance exam identified); Clinical specialisation: Master's degree in Psychology required before M.Phil Clinical Psychology entrance. Typical duration: BA/BSc 3 years + MA/MSc 2 years (5 years for a Master's); +2 years M.Phil Clinical Psychology for licensed clinical practice
govt_private_options: Govt: Government universities/institutes offering BA/MA Psychology (e.g. Andhra University); premier govt clinical-psychology institutes include NIMHANS Bangalore, IHBAS Delhi, CIP Ranchi. Private: Numerous private colleges/universities offer BA/MA Psychology; private practice common after RCI registration, alongside corporate HR and school-counsellor roles (growing under NEP 2020)
next_step: Without RCI registration, a psychology graduate cannot legally practice clinical assessment/therapy in India; RCI-registered psychologists work in govt hospitals, private practice, schools, or corporate HR; PhD enables academic/senior clinical roles
source: brighttutorials.in How to Become a Psychologist in India (2026) guide - unverified: AP-specific psychology/counselling entrance exam or state licensing body, needs follow-up

entry_point: After Class 12 (any stream) for a bachelor's; after a degree for IIMC
required_exams: CUET-UG for journalism/mass communication degrees at participating universities; CUET-PG for IIMC's MA and PG Diploma programmes
eligibility: CUET-UG: Class 12 pass or appearing, any stream, no age limit. IIMC PG Diplomas: graduates in any discipline (final-year students may apply); IIMC MA programmes: a bachelor's degree with at least 55%
govt_private_options: Central, state and private universities through CUET-UG; IIMC (Delhi and regional campuses) through CUET-PG
next_step: Reporting, editing, broadcasting, digital media and public relations roles
source: Exams tab (verified): NTA CUET (UG) 2026 press releases; Indian Institute of Mass Communication, Admission Notice (2026-27): iimc.gov.in/files/announcements/Admission-Notice-2026-27.pdf

entry_point: After Class 12 (or while awaiting Class 12 results)
required_exams: ACET (Actuarial Common Entrance Test) -> student membership of the Institute of Actuaries of India -> IAI actuarial exams
eligibility: Students who have appeared for 10+2 and await results, or anyone who has passed 10+2 or higher (graduates, engineers, CAs, CMAs, CSs and others). The ACET result is valid for 3 years for taking IAI student membership
govt_private_options: A professional qualification of the Institute of Actuaries of India (a statutory body), not a college degree; most students work while clearing the exams
next_step: Clear the IAI exams to become an Associate and then a Fellow, working in insurance, pensions and risk consulting
source: Institute of Actuaries of India, About ACET: actuariesindia.org/about-acet

career_name: Merchant Navy - Officer Cadre (Nautical Science / Marine Engineering)
entry_point: After Intermediate MPC
required_exams: IMU CET (Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test) for B.Tech Marine Engineering, B.Sc Nautical Science and other IMU programmes
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths: 60% aggregate in PCM (5% relaxation for SC/ST) and 50% in English. Maximum age for men 25 (OBC-NCL 28, SC/ST 30), for women 27 (OBC-NCL 30, SC/ST 32), counted from the start of the academic session. Must meet the Merchant Shipping medical standards
govt_private_options: Indian Maritime University (a central university) campuses and its affiliated institutes
next_step: Sail as a trainee officer, gain sea time and pass the competency exams to rise to Chief Engineer or Master (Captain)
source: Indian Maritime University, B.Tech (Marine Engineering) programme page: imu.edu.in/imunew/course-programs?course=2

entry_point: After Intermediate - BiPC
required_exams: NEET-UG is required for BPT admission in the 2026-27 cycle at most institutions, alongside Intermediate BiPC (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Zoology & Botany)
eligibility: Intermediate BiPC pass with a minimum of 50% aggregate in PCB from a recognised board or NIOS; NEET-UG qualifying score as per the admitting institution/state counselling Typical duration: 5 years total (4 academic years + 1 year compulsory clinical internship).
govt_private_options: Govt: Govt medical/physiotherapy colleges in AP admitting via NEET-based state counselling (limited govt seats) Private: Numerous private physiotherapy colleges across AP and nationally, admitting via NEET score through management/private counselling
next_step: BPT graduates can prefix 'Dr.' and suffix 'PT' per National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) rules; careers include hospital/clinic physiotherapist, sports-team physiotherapist, or further study via MPT (Master of Physiotherapy) for specialisation/teaching roles
source: manavrachna.edu.in Is NEET Compulsory for BPT Admission 2026 guide - unverified: name of the specific AP state registration/licensing council for physiotherapists, needs follow-up

career_name: Social Work (MSW - Master of Social Work)
entry_point: After any bachelor's degree
required_exams: AP PGCET for MSW at Andhra Pradesh universities; CUET-PG for TISS (MA Social Work) and other central universities
eligibility: A bachelor's degree (course-wise conditions on the APPGCET portal; single-subject distance degrees are not eligible). TISS admits on the CUET-PG 2026 score alone (100% weightage), with no group discussion or interview
govt_private_options: University campus, constituent and affiliated colleges in AP through AP PGCET; TISS campuses (Mumbai, Tuljapur, Hyderabad, Guwahati) through CUET-PG
next_step: Medical and psychiatric social work, NGO and community development, CSR, school counselling, or lectureship after NET/SET
source: Exams tab (verified): APPGCET-2026 General Instructions (Sri Venkateswara University for APSCHE); TISS Admission Brochure for Post Graduate Programmes 2026-2027: tiss.ac.in/uploads/files/PG_Admission_Brochure_2026-2027-v3_kDx1Bo7.pdf

entry_point: After Intermediate MPC (B.Tech) or after Class 12 (B.Sc / BCA)
required_exams: AP EAPCET (Engineering stream) for B.Tech CSE (Data Science / AI & ML) branches; B.Sc and BCA in AP degree colleges through the OAMDC online admissions
eligibility: B.Tech: Intermediate MPC with at least 45% in the qualifying subjects (40% for reserved categories). B.Sc / BCA: as notified on OAMDC for each course
govt_private_options: Government and private engineering colleges through AP EAPCET counselling; degree colleges through OAMDC
next_step: Data analyst and data scientist roles, or M.Tech / M.Sc in data science
source: Exams tab (verified): APEAPCET-2026 Instruction Booklet; OAMDC (APSCHE) FAQs: oamdc.ap.gov.in/FAQS.do

entry_point: After Intermediate (MPC for B.Tech Dairy Technology; BiPC for B.F.Sc Fisheries)
required_exams: AP EAPCET: Engineering stream for B.Tech (Dairy Technology), Agriculture & Pharmacy stream for B.F.Sc; CUET-UG for ICAR-affiliated universities in other states
eligibility: Intermediate MPC (Dairy Technology) or BiPC (Fisheries) with at least 45% in the qualifying subjects (40% for reserved categories) and AP local/non-local status
govt_private_options: State agricultural and veterinary university colleges in Andhra Pradesh through AP EAPCET counselling
next_step: Dairy development and fisheries department jobs, dairy processing and aquaculture industry, or M.Tech / M.F.Sc / PhD
source: Exams tab (verified): APEAPCET-2026 Instruction Booklet (courses admitted include B.Tech (Dairy Technology) and B.F.Sc); NTA ICAR AIEEA (PG)-2026 Information Bulletin (UG at ICAR-affiliated universities through CUET-UG)

entry_point: After Class 12 (Category A, eminent sportspersons) or after a degree (Category B)
required_exams: SAI NSNIS Diploma Course in Sports Coaching: online application, then an online admission test for eligible candidates (Category A sportspersons are admitted directly, subject to medical, fitness and skill tests)
eligibility: Category A: Class 12 pass plus Olympic, World Championship, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games or similar participation/medals. Category B: a degree plus participation in major international competitions, recognised senior nationals, Khelo India University Games or All India Inter-University Games (or two junior nationals/Khelo India Youth Games). Para-athletes in listed sports can also apply
govt_private_options: Sports Authority of India's NSNIS Patiala; private academies and clubs also employ coaches
next_step: Coaching at SAI centres, state sports departments, schools, colleges and academies
source: SAI Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports, Patiala: Admission to 64th Batch Diploma Course in Sports Coaching (Session 2026-27): nsnis.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Notification-for-Admission-to-Diploma-Course-in-Sports-Coaching-2026-27.pdf

career_name: Indian Air Force - Agniveer Vayu (Airmen) & AFCAT (Officer Entry)
entry_point: After Class 12 (Agniveer Vayu) or after graduation (AFCAT - officer entry)
required_exams: Agniveer Vayu: online written exam + physical fitness test + medical exam, for a 4-year short-service enlisted term; AFCAT (Air Force Common Admission Test, conducted by IAF): written exam -> AFSB (Air Force Selection Board) interview -> medical exam, for Flying/Ground Duty (Technical/Non-Technical) officer branches
eligibility: Agniveer Vayu: age 17.5-21 years, Class 12 pass with minimum 50% overall and 50% in English (Science-stream candidates need Physics, Chemistry, Maths for certain trades); unmarried male and female candidates. AFCAT: graduation-level eligibility with branch-specific degree/marks requirements (e.g. Engineering degree for Technical branch, specific Maths/Physics at Class 12 for Flying branch) - exact AFCAT age range and minimum graduation percentage not independently verified this session, flagged below Typical duration: Agniveer Vayu: 4-year initial engagement (with a proportion retained for further full engagement based on performance); AFCAT: pre-commission training of varying length by branch (Flying branch training is the longest) at IAF training academies.
govt_private_options: Govt: Sole route: Indian Air Force (Govt of India, Ministry of Defence) - no private equivalent for either entry Private: N/A (defence recruitment has no private-sector equivalent); private coaching academies support Agniveer Vayu/AFCAT exam preparation only
next_step: Agniveer Vayu: service in technical/non-technical airman trades, with a review after 4 years for retention of a subset of Agniveers into regular Air Force service; AFCAT: commission as an IAF officer in Flying, Technical, or Ground Duty (Non-Technical) branches, with career progression through officer ranks
source: pw.live Indian Air Force Agniveer Eligibility Criteria guide (Agniveer Vayu figures); testbook.com AFCAT Eligibility guide (AFCAT exists but exact age/marks figures were not confirmed this session) - unverified: precise AFCAT age range and minimum graduation percentage, needs follow-up

entry_point: After Class 12 (any stream)

govt_private_options: Govt: Govt-run fine arts colleges and university fine-arts/performing-arts departments (e.g. Andhra University College of Fine Arts) admitting via their own entrance test/portfolio review Private: Numerous private fine arts and performing arts institutes across India (and a smaller number in AP) admit via their own entrance tests or portfolio review
next_step: Careers as a practising Painter/Sculptor/Applied Artist, Dancer/Choreographer/Theatre Artist/Musician, Art Teacher (with a further B.Ed), Art Director in film/media, or further study (MFA) for academia/curation roles
source: shiksha.com BFA Admission 2026 guide - unverified: AP-specific fine/performing arts entrance exam name and BFA duration breakdown, needs follow-up

required_exams: No entrance exam: training at a DGCA-approved Flying Training Organisation, plus the DGCA flight crew licence exams taken through pariksha.dgca.gov.in (requirements in DGCA CAR Section 7, Series B, Part I)
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics and Maths from a recognised board (passed in both subjects); no maximum age to register as a flight crew candidate
govt_private_options: DGCA-approved Flying Training Organisations
next_step: After the licence, join an airline as a First Officer, do a type rating, and work up to Captain
source: DGCA Pariksha FAQs for flight crew: pariksha.dgca.gov.in/Form/PLT_FAQs (FAQ 7-9)

entry_point: After Class 12 (any stream) for domestic airlines; a bachelor's degree strengthens applications to international carriers
required_exams: No entrance exam; airline-specific recruitment (walk-in interviews, group discussion, personal interview) followed by the airline's in-house cabin-crew training (safety/emergency procedures, first aid) and DGCA-mandated safety certification before flying duty
eligibility: Class 12 pass, any stream; age typically 17/18-26/27 years for freshers (up to 30 years for experienced candidates at some airlines); height minimum approx. 157cm/5'2" (female) or 170cm/5'7" (male); BMI-proportionate weight; correctable vision, no visible tattoos, normal hearing; mandatory English fluency, Hindi/regional language an advantage Typical duration: Airline in-house training typically 6-8 weeks before first flying duty.
govt_private_options: Govt: No dedicated state-government cabin-crew cadre currently; Air India (majority-private since disinvestment, but with legacy public-sector heritage) runs its own trainee cabin crew programme Private: IndiGo, SpiceJet, Vistara/Air India Group, Akasa Air and other private airlines run in-house cabin-crew recruitment and training; private aviation-training academies (e.g. Frankfinn, Blue Ocean) offer optional IATA-aligned preparatory courses
next_step: Trainee/Junior Cabin Crew -> Senior Cabin Crew -> Cabin Crew Instructor or In-Flight Supervisor with experience; some cabin crew transition into ground staff or airport/airline management roles
source: blueoceancorporation.in Cabin Crew Eligibility Criteria in India - Complete 2026 Guide

entry_point: After Class 12 (any stream)
required_exams: NIFT entrance (B.Des Fashion Interiors), NID DAT, UCEED, or a college's own design test
eligibility: NIFT B.Des: Class 12 in any stream, under 24 on 1 August of the admission year (5 years' relaxation for SC/ST/PwD). UCEED: Class 12 in any stream, at most two attempts, with the birth-date limits in the brochure
govt_private_options: NIFT (including NIFT Hyderabad), NIDs and IITs; private design colleges with their own tests or these scores

required_exams: No dedicated national entrance exam. eligibility: Certificate: Class 12 pass, any stream; Diploma: Class 12 pass with approx. 55% aggregate; Bachelor's (BBA/BMS): Class 12 pass with approx. 50-55%; Master's: Bachelor's degree with a minimum of approx. 60% Typical duration: Certificate: a few months; Diploma: 1 year; Bachelor's: 3 years; Master's: 2 years.
govt_private_options: Govt: IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University) offers a low-cost certificate/diploma programme in event management; some state university departments offer event management as a specialisation within BBA/MBA Private: Numerous private institutes (e.g. NIEM, AAFT, GEMS B-School and others) with fees ranging widely, roughly from Rs 8, 000 (IGNOU) to Rs 4.35 lakh depending on institute and course level
next_step: Entry as Event Coordinator/Assistant -> Event Manager -> Wedding Planner or Marketing Manager, or independent event-management business; reported salary range roughly Rs 2.9-9 lakh/year depending on role and experience

entry_point: After Intermediate/Class 12 (any stream); some certificate-level courses accept Class 10 pass
required_exams: No dedicated national entrance exam identified; admission to certificate/diploma courses is usually direct or portfolio-based; BA/BFA/B.Sc Photography degree programmes admit via the institute's own aptitude test/portfolio review, or at design-oriented institutes via design entrance exams
eligibility: Class 10 or Class 12 pass (requirement varies by course level and institute) from a recognised board; no fixed minimum percentage commonly specified Typical duration: Certificate: 3-6 months; Diploma: 1-3 years; Bachelor's (BA/BFA/B.Sc Photography): 3 years.
govt_private_options: Govt: University departments such as Jawaharlal Nehru Architecture and Fine Arts University (JNAFAU, Hyderabad, Telangana) and Osmania University offer photography-adjacent fine-arts programmes serving the AP region; an AP-specific standalone government photography degree programme was not independently identified this session - flagged for follow-up Private: Numerous private institutes nationwide (e.g. Asian Academy of Film & Television, Creative Hut Institute of Photography, World University of Design and others); fees range roughly from Rs 15, 000-25, 000 (certificate, 3-6 months) to about Rs 2 lakh (diploma, 1-3 years) to Rs 57, 000+ (BA, 3 years, varies by institute)
next_step: Entry as a photography assistant or freelancer -> specialisation (wedding, wildlife, photojournalism, advertising, fashion) -> independent studio/freelance practice or staff photographer roles in media and advertising; entry salaries approx. Rs 1 lakh/year rising to roughly Rs 3-5 lakh/year with experience

entry_point: After Class 10 (SSC/CBSE/ICSE, any recognised board)
required_exams: No Common Entrance Test for GP Rating; selection via institute-level written test/interview plus DG Shipping medical exam; DGS-approved 6-month Pre-Sea GP Rating course
eligibility: Pass SSC/10th with >=40% aggregate and >=40% in English (10th or 12th); age <=25 years at course commencement; height >=157cm, weight >=48kg; DG Shipping medical fitness incl. eyesight 6/12 each eye or 6/9+6/18 (correctable), no colour blindness Typical duration: 6 months residential pre-sea training.
govt_private_options: Govt: DG Shipping-approved government-linked maritime training institutes (e.g. T.S. Rs 2 lakh)

source: officersmaritimeacademy.com GP Rating course guide

entry_point: After Class 10 (certificate courses) or Class 12 (diploma/degree courses)
required_exams: NCHMCT JEE for admission to Government IHMs (Institutes of Hotel Management) and NCHMCT-affiliated colleges; most private culinary institutes admit via direct/merit-based process without a common entrance test
eligibility: Class 12 pass (any stream) for degree/diploma programmes, commonly ~50% aggregate expected by private institutes; NCHMCT JEE requires Class 12 pass with English as a core/compulsory subject; some 6-month certificate courses accept Class 10 pass Typical duration: 6 months (certificate) to 2 years (diploma craft courses); BHM/BSc Hospitality degree route is 3-4 years (see Hotel Management row in Phase 4 Major).

next_step: Employment as commis chef/kitchen trainee in hotels, restaurants, airlines, cruise liners; progression to Chef de Partie -> Sous Chef -> Executive Chef with experience; can also pursue the BSc HHA/further hotel-management study already covered in Phase 4, or entrepreneurship (own bakery/restaurant/cloud kitchen)

entry_point: After Class 10 (minimum); open to career-switchers at any later stage, no upper schooling requirement

eligibility: Minimum age 18 years; minimum Class 10 pass; valid DGCA medical certificate (Class 2 equivalent, from an authorised examiner, valid 2 years under age 40 / 1 year above 40) Typical duration: Practical training typically 2-5 days of hands-on flying after theory preparation; RPC processing 7-15 working days after passing; certificate valid 10 years.

Rs 100) Private: Numerous DGCA-authorised private Remote Pilot Training Organisations (RPTOs) conduct the actual training (fees roughly Rs 15, 000-Rs 50, 000)

eligibility: SSC: 12th pass; age 18-30 (Grade C) / 18-27 (Grade D); skill test requires 10-min dictation, transcription at 100 wpm (Grade C) / 80 wpm (Grade D). next_step: Stenographer Grade D -> Grade C -> Personal Assistant/Private Secretary in courts or central ministries; further promotion to PS to judges/senior officials
source: ezssc.in SSC Steno guide; careerera.com AP High Court Stenographer recruitment guide

source: wii.gov.in M.Sc Wildlife Science page; collegedekho.com WII admission guide

entry_point: After Intermediate (10+2)
required_exams: BASLP (Bachelor of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology) - 4 years (3 years academics + 1 year compulsory clinical internship). Admission via NEET-UG, IPU CET, or the AYJNISHD(D) entrance exam at some institutes; several private colleges admit on 12th-grade merit instead. Registration with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) Central Rehabilitation Register (CRR) is required to practice professionally after graduation.
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Mathematics as compulsory subjects; minimum 50% aggregate (45% for SC/ST/OBC at many institutes). Some universities set a minimum age of 17 by 31 Dec of the admission year. Typical duration: 4 years total (3 years coursework + 1 year clinical internship).
govt_private_options: Govt: Government-run/aided BASLP programmes exist nationally (e.g. under AYJNISHD(D) and government medical-university-affiliated colleges), fees roughly Rs 20, 000-80, 000/year; AP's NTRUHS paramedical counselling (covering BPT, MLT, Radiology, Optometry at Andhra Medical College, Guntur Medical College, Siddhartha Medical College etc.) does not appear to list a dedicated BASLP seat - unverified, needs follow-up whether AP has a government BASLP college Private: Numerous private BASLP colleges across India, fees roughly Rs 50, 000-5 lakh/year; specific AP-based private BASLP college names not independently confirmed - unverified, needs follow-up
next_step: Practice as Clinical Audiologist, Speech-Language Pathologist, Hearing Aid Specialist, or special-school instructor in government hospitals, private clinics, NGOs, or hearing-aid manufacturers after RCI-CRR registration; further study via MSc Audiology & Speech-Language Pathology or doctoral research
source: collegedunia.com BASLP course guide; baslpcourse.com (RCI/CRR); manabadi.co.in AP paramedical counselling guide

entry_point: After Intermediate - BiPC (Biology, Physics, Chemistry)
required_exams: BOT/BOTh - a 4-year academic programme with a further internship (some sources describe 4 years inclusive of a 1-year internship, others 4 years + 6 months separately - exact split varies by institute, unverified). Admission typically merit-based on 12th marks; a few institutes use NEET or their own entrance test. Regulation is transitioning to the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) under the Allied and Healthcare Professions Act 2021, phasing in mandatory registration and standardised curricula
eligibility: 10+2 in Science with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (BiPC); minimum percentage commonly around 45-50% but varies by institute - exact universal cutoff unverified, needs follow-up Typical duration: 4 to 4.5 years (core coursework + 6-month to 1-year internship, varies by source).
govt_private_options: Govt: AP's NTRUHS-affiliated government paramedical colleges (Andhra Medical College, Guntur Medical College, Siddhartha Medical College, Kurnool Medical College, Sri Venkateswara Medical College) run allied-health courses, but a confirmed AP government BOT seat under NTRUHS counselling could not be verified - unverified, needs follow-up. Government-run OT programmes exist elsewhere in India (e.g. NIPMR, WFOT-listed govt medical colleges) Private: Aditya College of Allied Health Sciences (Andhra Pradesh) offers BOT (10+2 Science eligibility, 4 years + 6 months internship); other private WFOT-listed institutes nationally include SRM College of Occupational Therapy, JSS Medical College, Saveetha College of Occupational Therapy
next_step: Employment in hospital rehabilitation/neuro/ortho/psychiatric units, rehabilitation centres, special-needs schools, geriatric care facilities, or NGOs; further paths include assistive-technology consulting, rehabilitation coordination, ergonomics consulting, or postgraduate specialisation (MOT)
source: shiksha.com BOT course guide; adityacollegeofalliedsciences.com; wfot.org education programme listings; en.wikipedia.org National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions

entry_point: After Class 10 (SSC) - a shorter polytechnic-diploma route, distinct from the 5.5-year BVSc degree already covered under Phase 4 Major
required_exams: 2-year Diploma in Animal Husbandry (also offered as separate streams: Veterinary Science & Animal Husbandry, Dairy Polytechnic, Veterinary Pharmacy, Veterinary Lab Technician, Veterinary Livestock Inspector) run by Sri Venkateswara Veterinary University (SVVU), Tirupati. Admission is merit-based on 10th-class marks via SVVU counselling (apsvvu-diplomaadmissions.aptonline.in) - no separate entrance exam. Government recruitment as Animal Husbandry Assistant/Livestock Inspector follows via a standard written recruitment exam - exact recruiting body/notification cycle varies, verify current APPSC/AP Staff Selection notification
eligibility: Completion of 10th class (SSC) with Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) from a recognised board; age typically 15-22 for diploma admission. For the government Animal Husbandry Assistant post: age 18-42 (general, with 5-10 year reserved-category relaxation); qualifying credential can be the 2-year SVVU diploma, an Intermediate Vocational course in Dairying/Poultry Science, B.Sc/B.Tech Dairy Technology, Diploma in Veterinary Science, or B.Voc in Dairying & Animal Husbandry Typical duration: 2 years (diploma) plus time to clear the subsequent government recruitment exam.
govt_private_options: Govt: Sri Venkateswara Veterinary University (SVVU), Tirupati - government-run 2-year Diploma in Animal Husbandry across its polytechnic colleges (e.g. Animal Husbandry Polytechnic, Venkataramannagudem) is the primary AP government route; graduates are eligible for AP government recruitment as Animal Husbandry Assistant/Livestock Inspector Private: Limited private polytechnic diploma options in animal husbandry/dairy science exist in AP, but government SVVU-run diplomas dominate this pathway; specific private institute names not verified - needs follow-up
next_step: Employment as Veterinary Assistant, Veterinary Technician, or Animal Health/Livestock Inspector in the AP Animal Husbandry Department; can progress with further study (B.Voc, B.Sc Dairy Science) or apply for higher departmental posts; diploma holders may also work in private dairy/poultry industries
source: testbook.com AP Animal Husbandry Assistant eligibility guide; teachersbadi.in AP Veterinary Polytechnic diploma admission guide; svvu.edu.in Diploma in Animal Husbandry prospectus

entry_point: After a Bachelor's degree (graduate-level entry)
required_exams: APPSC Junior Translator (Telugu) recruitment under the A.P. Translation Sub Service - written examination (Telugu & English grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, translation) followed by a skill/practical translation test. Separately, various High Courts and District Courts nationally (Patna, Gujarat, Orissa, Rajasthan, Kerala, Calcutta, etc.) run their own direct Translator/Interpreter recruitment; whether AP High Court currently runs a standalone Translator/Interpreter cadre distinct from the APPSC Translation Sub Service was not confirmed - unverified, needs follow-up. An optional Post Graduate Diploma in Translation (PGDT, e.g. via IGNOU) strengthens candidacy though is not always mandatory
eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university, typically with the regional language (e.g. Telugu) as a subject plus demonstrated proficiency in both the regional language and English. Age limits vary by state/court (e.g. Patna HC: 18-37 general, up to 42 SC/ST, up to 47 PwD) - AP-specific age limit for Junior Translator not separately confirmed, needs follow-up Typical duration: 3 years (Bachelor's degree) minimum entry qualification; recruitment-exam cycle itself typically takes several months to over a year; an optional PGDT adds 1 year.
govt_private_options: Govt: APPSC Junior Translator (Telugu) post under the A.P. Translation Sub Service (Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission) is the clearest AP government route; other state High Courts/District Courts and the Supreme Court of India also run periodic direct Translator/Interpreter recruitment Private: No formal private institutional route exists (it is a government appointment); private-sector equivalents are freelance/agency legal translation and interpretation work, or corporate/legal-firm translator roles, which do not require a government exam but benefit from a PGDT or translation certification
next_step: Appointment as Junior Translator/Interpreter in AP government/judicial service; career progression to Senior Translator or administrative roles within the court/government translation service based on experience and departmental promotions
source: andhrapradesh.pscnotes.com APPSC Junior Translator (Telugu) guide; testbook.com Patna High Court Translator eligibility guide; aphc.gov.in AP High Court recruitment notifications; ignouadmission.samarth.edu.in PGDT

entry_point: After a Bachelor's degree (any discipline); rigorous programmes often additionally expect 2-5 years of work experience
required_exams: No single licensing exam exists in India. Common paths: IICA (Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs, Ministry of Corporate Affairs) Certified ESG Professional programme; IGNOU Post Graduate Diploma in Environment and Sustainable Development (PGDESD); GRI Certified Sustainability Professional (4 mandatory GRI courses then a 40-question, 60-minute exam, 75% pass mark); private Indian options such as Symbiosis (SCDL) Certificate in ESG Management and Reporting or IGMPI's ESG diploma
eligibility: IICA: graduate in any discipline + minimum 5 years' relevant experience + employed at an MSME with a valid Udyam Registration Number. IGNOU PGDESD: graduate in any discipline, no minimum % stated. SCDL: graduate in any discipline, or diploma holder with 5 years' experience. GRI: no formal prerequisite beyond completing its own courses Typical duration: 6 months to 2 years depending on programme (GRI: weeks; SCDL/IICA: 6 months; IGNOU: 12-24 months).
govt_private_options: Govt: IICA Certified ESG Professional (Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Govt of India) - 6-month programme, fee approx. Rs 2, 0.0, 000 (subsidised in some past sponsored batches - verify current terms); IGNOU PGDESD - central open university, ODL mode, 12-24 months, approx. Rs 7, 200 total fee. No AP state-specific govt ESG certification body identified - unverified, needs follow-up Private: Symbiosis Centre for Distance Learning (SCDL) Certificate in ESG Management and Reporting (6 months, online, AICTE-approved institution); IGMPI PG/Executive Diploma in ESG (duration/fees not published, unverified); GRI Certified Sustainability Professional (self-paced ~13 hrs or instructor-led, global programme)
next_step: Entry as ESG/Sustainability Analyst or Associate at consulting firms, corporate sustainability/CSR departments, or as an independent GRI-reporting consultant; with experience, progression to ESG Manager, Chief Sustainability Officer, or specialised BRSR (Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting) compliance roles for listed Indian companies
source: iica.nic.in Certified ESG Professional; ignou.ac.in PGDESD; globalreporting.org GRI certification; scdl.net ESG Management and Reporting certificate; igmpi.ac.in ESG diploma

entry_point: After Class 10 or 12 (no board-specific stream required; largely open to any education level in practice)
required_exams: No national licensing exam, NCVT/ITI-recognised trade, or NSDC/PMKVY qualification pack for pet grooming was identified in India - unverified, needs follow-up (this appears to be a genuinely private-sector-only training pipeline at present). Path is entirely through private academy certificate programmes of increasing levels (entry/beginner to intermediate to advanced/professional stylist)
eligibility: No formal minimum education or age criteria enforced by the private academies reviewed; entry is open generally, with 12th-grade completion informally preferred but not mandatory at most academies Typical duration: 10 days (entry-level) to 2-3 months (comprehensive/advanced certification).
govt_private_options: Govt: No dedicated central or AP state government pet-grooming certification, ITI trade, or NSDC-affiliated qualification pack identified - unverified, needs follow-up Private: ThePetNest Grooming Academy (Bengaluru/Noida/Mumbai) - 4-tier programme (Apprenticeship to Advanced, 140+ hours, fees roughly Rs 35, 000-2, 19.0, 000); Petswag Grooming Academy (Mumbai) - 3-tier programme (10/20/30 days); IPPC (Ajarva Technologies) - grooming/training/walking academies, fees from roughly Rs 2, 000-70, 000+; Academy of Grooming Arts (Coimbatore/Kochi)
next_step: Employment at pet salons/grooming chains or veterinary clinics, freelance/mobile grooming services, or opening an independent grooming salon; reported earnings vary widely by skill, clientele and city (self-reported by training academies, not independently verified)
source: thepetnest.com pet grooming course guide; petswagacademy.com; ippcedu.com; academyofgroomingarts.com

entry_point: After Class 10/12 or at any later age; no formal culinary degree required to start a home-based food business (distinct from being an employed chef, already covered under Phase 4 Major - Hotel Management/Culinary Arts)
required_exams: No exam is required to sell baked goods legally; the mandatory legal step is FSSAI registration or licensing via the FoSCoS portal (foscos.fssai.gov.in). Skill-building is optional, via short private-academy courses or government-run Food Craft Institutes. A Food Safety Supervisor (FoSTaC) certification is recommended for licensed units, but was not confirmed as mandatory for Basic-Registration-tier home bakers - unverified, needs follow-up
eligibility: FSSAI Basic Registration required for annual turnover up to Rs 12 lakh (fee approx. Rs 100/year); State License for turnover Rs 12 lakh-20 crore (fee approx. Rs 2, 000-5, 000/year); Central License above Rs 20 crore. Applicant needs proof of premises and a list of food items; licence validity selectable 1-5 years since a Nov 2023 FSSAI order Typical duration: FSSAI registration typically processed within days to a few weeks online; skill courses range from a few weeks up to 6 weeks-1 year.
govt_private_options: Govt: FSSAI Basic Registration/State/Central Licence (mandatory legal route, via FoSCoS portal); PMFME (PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises) Scheme, Ministry of Food Processing Industries - 35% credit-linked capital subsidy (capped at Rs 10 lakh/unit), implemented in AP by the Andhra Pradesh Food Processing Society (APFPS, portal apfpregistry.in), targeting roughly 10, 035 micro enterprises statewide; Food Craft Institute, Visakhapatnam offers a 1-year Certificate in Bakery & Confectionery (10+2 pass, merit-based, fee approx. Rs 18, 000-20, 000) - its precise govt/autonomous management status unverified Private: Private culinary academies offer short bakery/confectionery certificate courses, e.g. Lavonne Academy of Baking Science & Pastry Arts (Bangalore/Delhi) 6-Week Certificate Programme (age 18+, 12th pass, fee approx. Rs 2, 98.0, 000 incl. GST); these are optional skill add-ons, not legally required to start a bakery business
next_step: After FSSAI registration and optional skill training, entrepreneurs typically start as home bakers/cloud kitchens, scale to a licensed small bakery/cafe as turnover grows (triggering upgrade to State License), and can access PMFME subsidy for equipment/infrastructure; further growth may lead to branded retail outlets, wholesale supply, or franchise models
source: cleartax.in FSSAI registration for home bakers guide; foscos.fssai.gov.in official eligibility document; pib.gov.in PMFME scheme; pmfmeap.org (AP PMFME/APFPS); collegedunia.com Food Craft Institute Visakhapatnam; lavonne.in Six-Week Certificate programme

career_name: State Civil Services (Telangana Group services via TSPSC) (major)
entry_point: Bachelor's degree (any discipline) from a recognized university, followed by Telangana State Public Service Commission (TSPSC) Group 1/2/3/4 recruitment
required_exams: TSPSC Group 1 (Prelims + Mains + Interview/Document Verification, 2026 notification expected soon per TSPSC Chairman's statement around Telangana Formation Day 2026); TSPSC Group 2 (single written exam, 783 vacancies in the most recent cycle); TSPSC Group 3 and Group 4 (single written exam each)
eligibility: Group 1: Bachelor's degree, age 18-46 (with reserved-category relaxations); Group 2: Bachelor's degree, age 21-30, must be fluent in the regional language of the state; Group 4: Bachelor's degree, Telangana-local reservation benefits apply (non-locals may apply only under the Open category)
govt_private_options: Government only (public service). Group 1 posts include Deputy Collector, Deputy Superintendent of Police, District Registrar and other gazetted posts; Group 2 posts include Assistant Labour Officer, Assistant Commercial Tax Officer (ACTO), Sub-Registrar Grade-II, Extension Officer; Group 4 posts include Junior Assistant, Junior Accountant, Junior Auditor, Ward Officer
next_step: Clear the relevant TSPSC written exam stage(s) (and interview for Group 1) to be appointed to a gazetted or non-gazetted Telangana state government post, with promotion tracks within the respective department
source: testbook.com TSPSC Group 1 Recruitment 2026; careerpower.in TSPSC Group 2 2026 (783 vacancies); careerpower.in / prepp.in TSPSC Group 4 Recruitment 2026 eligibility; official site tspsc.gov.in named in all aggregator sources

career_name: Government Group-D/Constable-Level Jobs - Telangana (TS Police Constable via TSLPRB, TSPSC Group-4) (major)
entry_point: Intermediate (10+2) pass for TS Police Constable/Fire Fighter/Warder posts; Bachelor's degree for TSPSC Group-4 (Junior Assistant and similar) posts
required_exams: TSLPRB Police Constable Preliminary Written Test + Physical Efficiency Test (PET) + Final Written Test (2026 notification dated 29 July 2026 for 7,112 vacancies covering Police Constable, Special Protection Force Constable, Fire Fighter and Warder; Prelims held 20 December 2026); TSPSC Group 4 single written exam
eligibility: Police recruitment: pass in Intermediate or equivalent recognized by the state government as of the notification date; upper age limit 29 years as of 1 July 2026 per the 15 August 2026 supplementary relaxation notice; Fire Fighter posts additionally require a valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) driving license; Group 4: Bachelor's degree, Telangana-local reservation applies
govt_private_options: Government only, via the Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB) for police/fire posts and TSPSC for Group-4 civil posts
next_step: Clear Prelims -> PET -> Final Written Test (police posts) or the single written exam (Group 4) to be appointed as Constable/Fire Fighter/Warder or Junior Assistant, with departmental promotion tracks thereafter
source: testbook.com Telangana Police Constable Recruitment 2026 (7,112/7,139 vacancies, notification 29-07-2026); official notification PDF at tgprb.in (PC (Civil et al) 2026 Notification dated 29-07-2026); careerpower.in TSPSC Group 4 Recruitment 2026 eligibility

career_name: School Teaching - Telangana (TS TET & TG DSC via Telangana School Education Dept) (major)
entry_point: D.Ed/B.Ed (as applicable to the post) plus a qualifying score in Telangana State Teacher Eligibility Test (TS TET), followed by the TG DSC (District Selection Committee) Teacher Recruitment Test for government-school posts
required_exams: TS TET - now conducted twice a year (June and December sessions) starting 2026, contributing 20% weightage to the overall Teacher Recruitment Test score; TG DSC/TRT - the main recruitment exam for Secondary Grade Teacher (SGT), School Assistant, Language Pandit, Physical Education Teacher, and Special Education Teacher posts (12,000-15,000+ vacancies expected across these categories in the 2026 cycle, not yet formally notified as of search)
eligibility: Valid AP TET / TS TET / CTET qualification; age 18-44 years for general category, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/BC/EWS and 10 years for PwD candidates
govt_private_options: Government schools: recruited centrally via TS TET + TG DSC administered by the Directorate of School Education, Government of Telangana; Private schools (CBSE/ICSE/state-board affiliated): hired directly by individual school managements, no centralized state exam required, though a valid teaching qualification (B.Ed/D.Ed) and often TET is still expected
next_step: Qualify TS TET -> apply for the TG DSC/Teacher Recruitment Test when notified -> merit-based selection -> posting to a government school post (SGT/School Assistant/Language Pandit/PET/Special Education Teacher)
source: adda247.com TG TET Notification 2026 (June session, twice-yearly change, 20% weightage); careerpower.in / onlineresult.in TS DSC 2026 Notification (vacancy estimate, eligibility, as-yet-unreleased notification per Sept 2026 status); teachersbadi.in TG DSC / TS TET portals (tgdsc.aptonline.in, schooledu.telangana.gov.in)

career_name: Forestry / Forest Range Officer - Telangana (TSPSC FRO & Forest Beat Officer) (niche)
entry_point: Forest Range Officer (FRO, gazetted): Bachelor's degree in Botany, Zoology, Geology, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Veterinary Science, Computer Science/Applications, or specified Engineering branches; Forest Beat Officer (FBO, frontline): Intermediate (10+2) pass
required_exams: FRO: TSPSC written exam + walking test + medical test + interview (67 vacancies in the most recent released cycle; 2026 FRO notification not yet released as of search); FBO: TSPSC 2-paper Computer-Based Test (General Knowledge + General Mathematics, 200 objective questions, 90 minutes each) + Physical Test (2026 notification for 1,393 FBO vacancies expected around Telangana Formation Day 2026 per TSPSC Chairman's statement)
eligibility: FRO: age 18-28 (relaxable for TS government employees, ex-servicemen, retrenched temporary Census Dept staff); FBO: age 18-31 (relaxable), Intermediate pass, prescribed physical/medical standards
govt_private_options: Government only, via the Telangana Forest Department under TSPSC recruitment
next_step: Clear the respective TSPSC selection process to be appointed as Forest Range Officer (gazetted, supervisory) or Forest Beat Officer (frontline field staff, with an internal promotion track toward Section Officer/Range Officer over a career)
source: testbook.com TSPSC FRO Eligibility Criteria; teachersbadi.in TSPSC Forest Range/Forest Section Officers recruitment; testbook.com / careerpower.in TSPSC Forest Beat Officer Notification 2026 (1,393 vacancies)

career_name: Court Stenography / Interpreter - Telangana (Telangana High Court) (niche)
entry_point: Direct recruitment via High Court for the State of Telangana (tshc.gov.in) recruitment notifications for Stenographer and allied posts; recruitment run independently of the Andhra Pradesh High Court since the two courts split in 2019

govt_private_options: Primarily Government (Telangana judiciary); private-sector court reporting/legal transcription work also exists but is not the main pipeline
next_step: Promotion track within Telangana High Court/District Courts (Stenographer Grade III to II to I); separate notifications cover Court Interpreter/Translator posts when vacancies arise
